title: 67dle - The 67 Number Game
tagline: Use four numbers and maths to make 67
description: A daily math puzzle. Combine four numbers with +, −, ×, ÷, ^ and ! to hit exactly 67.

title: Yeardle - Guess the year
tagline: Guess the year a historical event happened
description: A daily history puzzle — read the clue on the flashcard and guess the year in 5 tries.

title: Daily Hangman
description: A daily hangman puzzle — The classic hangman game where you guess letters one at a time until you get the word. Don't let that man hang!

title: Shikaku
tagline: Every number is a rectangle's area
description: A daily rectangle-division logic puzzle — draw rectangles so each one contains exactly one number, matching its area, until the whole grid is covered.

title: Sudoku-dle
tagline: Fill every row, column and box with 1-9
description: A daily Sudoku puzzle — fill the 9×9 grid so every row, column and box holds the digits 1–9, exactly once each.
